## Scenario (root)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Yes | — | Scenario ID: SC-001 |
| `name` | string | Yes | — | Human-readable scenario name |
| `description` | string | No | `""` | What this scenario verifies |
| `tags` | list[string] | No | `[]` | Tags for filtering runs |
| `depends_on` | list[string] | No | `[]` | Scenario IDs that must pass before this one runs (e.g. ['SC-001']) |
| `vars` | dict[string, string] | No | `{}` | Scenario-level variables (supports {{env.VAR}} references) |
| `steps` | list[StepConfig] | Yes | — | Ordered steps; at least one is required |
| `expect_login_redirect` | bool | No | `false` | Landing on a login page is expected throughout this scenario. Inherited by every step that does not set expect_login_redirect itself. Disables login-redirect detection for the whole file — prefer the step-level field unless the entire scenario tests access control. |
| `teardown` | list[TeardownStep] | No | `[]` | Cleanup steps executed after scenario completes (pass or fail) |
| `expected_result` | list[ExpectedResult] | No | `[]` | Scenario-level assertions checked after the last step |
| `variables` | dict[string, string] | No | `{}` | Alias of vars, kept for older scenario files |

## StepConfig

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `step` | int | Yes | — | Step number (1-based) |
| `action` | ActionType | Yes | — | What this step does |
| `target` | TargetSpec \| null | No | `null` | Element to act on; required by the find_and_* actions |
| `value` | string \| null | No | `null` | Action payload: URL, text to type, key name, coordinates |
| `description` | string | Yes | — | What this step is doing, in the tester's words |
| `humanize` | bool | No | `true` | Move and type like a person instead of instantly |
| `method` | FindMethod | No | `auto` | Matching method: auto (3-tier fallback), template, ocr, vision |
| `learn` | bool | No | `true` | Save successful match to pattern DB for future runs |
| `fallback` | bool | No | `true` | Allow tier fallback when specific method fails |
| `region` | ScreenRegion | No | `full` | Screen region to search: full, top, bottom, left, right, center, main |
| `threshold` | float | No | `0.05` | Change threshold for assert_screen_changed (0.0-1.0) |
| `verify` | bool | No | `false` | For type_text: verify typed text appears on screen via OCR |
| `message` | string | No | `""` | Custom error message for assert_text / assert_screen_changed |
| `match_index` | int | No | `0` | Select Nth match when multiple found (0=first, -1=last) |
| `name` | string | No | `""` | Session name for save_session/load_session |
| `if_visible` | bool | No | `false` | Only execute if target is visible on screen. Skip silently if not. |
| `critical` | bool | No | `false` | If True, test stops immediately on failure |
| `on_fail` | string | No | `""` | Action on failure: 'stop' to halt test immediately |
| `expect_login_redirect` | bool \| null | No | `null` | Landing on a login page is the expected outcome of this step (e.g. access-control tests). Disables the login-redirect hard stop for this step only. None = inherit the scenario-level setting. |
| `file_path` | string | No | `""` | File path for upload_file action |
| `file_paths` | list[string] | No | `[]` | Multiple file paths for upload_file action |
| `save_as` | string | No | `""` | Save result to runtime variable (for find/get_text) |
| `expect` | dict[string, Any] | No | `{}` | Post-action expectations: url_contains, text_visible, etc. |
| `then` | list[dict[string, Any]] | No | `[]` | Sub-steps to execute if if_visible target is found |
| `scenario` | string | No | `""` | Sub-scenario file path for include action |
| `vars` | dict[string, string] | No | `{}` | Variables to pass to included sub-scenario |
| `change_threshold` | float \| null | No | `null` | For critical steps: required pixel change ratio (auto-detected if None) |
| `wait_for` | string \| null | No | `null` | Wait for page load state after action: 'networkidle' \| 'load' \| 'domcontentloaded'. networkidle waits until no network requests for 500ms. |
| `screenshot_before` | bool | No | `false` | Capture the screen before acting |
| `screenshot_after` | bool | No | `false` | Capture the screen after acting |
| `timeout_ms` | int | No | `10000` | How long this step may take, in milliseconds |
| `optional` | bool | No | `false` | Record a failure as skipped instead of failing the scenario |
| `ai_verify` | bool \| null | No | `null` | Vision AI step verification. None=follow global config, True/False=override |
| `assert_type` | AssertType \| null | No | `null` | Kind of assertion; required by action=assert |
| `expected` | list[ExpectedResult] | No | `[]` | Assertions to check; required by action=assert |

## TargetSpec

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | string \| null | No | `null` | Target image relative path |
| `text` | string \| null | No | `null` | OCR fallback text |
| `selector` | string \| null | No | `null` | CSS selector (highest priority) |
| `icon` | IconHint \| null | No | `null` | Icon hint (future) |
| `match_method` | MatchMethod \| null | No | `null` | Force a specific matcher instead of the default chain |
| `confidence` | float \| null | No | `null` | Override the match confidence threshold |

At least one of `image`, `text`, `selector` or `icon` is required.

| `tolerance` | float | No | `0.0` | Allowed deviation for image/screen comparisons |

## TeardownStep

Cleanup that runs after the scenario finishes, whether it passed or failed. A
failing teardown step is logged and does not change the test result.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | Yes | — | 'api_call' \| 'db_query' \| 'shell' |
| `method` | string \| null | No | `null` | HTTP method: GET POST PUT DELETE PATCH |
| `url` | string \| null | No | `null` | Request URL (supports {{variables}}) |
| `headers` | dict[string, string] \| null | No | `null` | HTTP headers for api_call teardown |
| `body` | dict[string, Any] \| null | No | `null` | JSON request body for api_call teardown |
| `expected_status` | int \| null | No | `null` | Expected HTTP status code; failure logged but does not stop teardown |
| `connection` | string \| null | No | `null` | DB connection string, e.g. postgresql://host/db |
| `query` | string \| null | No | `null` | SQL to execute (supports {{variables}}) |
| `command` | string \| null | No | `null` | Shell command (supports {{variables}}) |
| `timeout` | int \| null | No | `30` | Shell command timeout in seconds |

## ActionType (26 values)

**Navigation**

- `navigate` — Open a URL
- `go_back` — Go back one entry in history
- `refresh` — Reload the current page

**Find + mouse**

- `find_and_click` — Click the element found by selector, text or image
- `find_and_double_click` — Double-click the element
- `find_and_right_click` — Right-click the element

**Find + keyboard**

- `find_and_type` — Focus the element, then type into it
- `find_and_clear` — Clear the element's content

**Direct**

- `click_at` — Click fixed coordinates
- `type_text` — Type into whatever has focus
- `press_key` — Press a single key
- `key_combo` — Press a key combination

**Assert**

- `assert` — Check `assert_type` against `expected`
- `assert_text` — Check that text is on screen (DOM first, OCR fallback)
- `assert_screen_changed` — Check the screen changed by at least `threshold`
- `assert_url` — Check the current URL contains a substring

**Session**

- `save_session` — Save cookies and storage under a name
- `load_session` — Restore a saved session

**Input**

- `upload_file` — Attach a file to a file input; needs `file_path` or `file_paths`

**Control flow**

- `if_visible` — Run the `then` sub-steps only if the target is visible
- `include` — Inline another scenario file

**Query**

- `find` — Locate an element without clicking it; pairs with `save_as`
- `get_text` — Read an element's text into a runtime variable via `save_as`

**Utility**

- `wait` — Wait
- `screenshot` — Capture the screen
- `scroll` — Scroll the page

## Action requirements

What each action needs in order to run. Cells marked ⚠ are needed by the handler
but not enforced by the validators, so `aat validate` lets them through.

| Action | Target | Value | Value format | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `navigate` | — | required | URL (supports `{{url}}`) | Open a URL |
| `go_back` | — | — | — | Go back one entry in history |
| `refresh` | — | — | — | Reload the current page |
| `find_and_click` | required | — | — | Click the element found by selector, text or image |
| `find_and_double_click` | required | — | — | Double-click the element |
| `find_and_right_click` | required | — | — | Right-click the element |
| `find_and_type` | required | required ⚠ | Text to type | Focus the element, then type into it |
| `find_and_clear` | required | — | — | Clear the element's content |
| `click_at` | — | required ⚠ | `x,y` | Click fixed coordinates |
| `type_text` | — | required ⚠ | Text to type | Type into whatever has focus |
| `press_key` | — | required ⚠ | `Enter`, `Tab`, `Escape`, ... | Press a single key |
| `key_combo` | — | required ⚠ | `Ctrl+A`, `Cmd+C` | Press a key combination |
| `assert` | — | — | Unused — see `expected` | Check `assert_type` against `expected` |
| `assert_text` | required | optional | Text to look for, if `target.text` is not used | Check that text is on screen (DOM first, OCR fallback) |
| `assert_screen_changed` | — | — | — | Check the screen changed by at least `threshold` |
| `assert_url` | — | required ⚠ | Substring, e.g. `/dashboard` | Check the current URL contains a substring |
| `save_session` | — | optional | Session name, if `name` is not used | Save cookies and storage under a name |
| `load_session` | — | optional | Session name, if `name` is not used | Restore a saved session |
| `upload_file` | optional | optional | Selector, if `target.selector` is not used | Attach a file to a file input; needs `file_path` or `file_paths` |
| `if_visible` | required ⚠ | — | — | Run the `then` sub-steps only if the target is visible |
| `include` | — | optional | Scenario path, if `scenario` is not used | Inline another scenario file |
| `find` | required | — | — | Locate an element without clicking it; pairs with `save_as` |
| `get_text` | optional | optional | Selector, if `target.selector` is not used | Read an element's text into a runtime variable via `save_as` |
| `wait` | — | optional | Milliseconds, e.g. `2000` | Wait |
| `screenshot` | — | — | — | Capture the screen |
| `scroll` | — | required ⚠ | `x,y,delta` (delta > 0 = down) | Scroll the page |

⚠ — needed at run time but **not** rejected by `aat validate`: `find_and_type`/`value`, `click_at`/`value`, `type_text`/`value`, `press_key`/`value`, `key_combo`/`value`, `assert_url`/`value`, `if_visible`/`target`, `scroll`/`value`. A step that omits one of these passes validation and then fails mid-run, so check these by hand when you write a scenario.

## AssertType

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `text_visible` | Text appears anywhere on the page |
| `text_equals` | Text matches exactly |
| `image_visible` | Image template is found on screen |
| `url_contains` | Current URL contains the substring |
| `url_not_contains` | Current URL does not contain the substring |
| `screenshot_match` | Screen matches a reference image |

## FindMethod (step-level)

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `auto` | Full chain (default): Semantics → template → OCR → Vision AI |
| `semantics` | Flutter Semantics only (aria-label / role lookup) |
| `template` | Template matching only (OpenCV) |
| `ocr` | OCR only (Tesseract with CLAHE + sharpening) |
| `vision` | Vision AI only (API call — costs money) |

With `fallback: true` (the default), a failed specific method falls back to the
full chain. `semantics` is activated automatically on Flutter CanvasKit apps.

## MatchMethod (target-level)

| Value | Algorithm | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| `learned` | SQLite lookup | Matches that already worked once |
| `semantics` | Flutter Semantics | Flutter CanvasKit apps |
| `template` | cv2.matchTemplate | Exact visual matching |
| `ocr` | pytesseract + CLAHE | Finding elements by their text |
| `feature` | ORB keypoints | Rotation- and scale-invariant matching |
| `vision_ai` | Claude / OpenAI / Gemini Vision | Canvas text, complex UIs |

## ScreenRegion

| Value | Area |
|---|---|
| `full` | Entire screen (default) |
| `top` | Top 30% |
| `bottom` | Bottom 30% |
| `left` | Left 20% |
| `right` | Right 80% |
| `center` | Central 60% x 60% |
| `main` | Everything except the left 20% (navigation excluded) |
